notes.title: Demo Update – Patch 1.08.07
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’ve just released Patch 1.08.07 for the demo version of Step Into the Dark. This update focuses on polishing the experience, fixing critical issues, and adding new content. Here’s what’s new:


[hr][/hr]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171201/4021f98196843680028da39523d38dc70b631fa7.png"]

Changes
 Gameplay

Prologue: Fixed a bug where the lever in the round gallery disappeared after death and reload, leaving the door locked.

Fixed an issue where old Prologue quests remained active after returning from the Arena.

Arena: Traders now correctly mark items as "private property" to prevent theft without consequences.

Prologue: After completing the quest to save Hans, he now moves from his position and reacts correctly.

Fixed an issue where the Mithril Fly would freeze after flying out.

Arena: Sabretooth no longer gets stuck in the basement near the entrance; camera works properly in dialogue.

Fixed "Shypach" behavior: now takes damage from thrown bricks.

Prologue: Fixed a bug with the quest behind the grate: it was previously issued and completed automatically despite being removed.

Fixed a bug where Marauders kept spawning shields on every hit.

 Sound

Fixed stone footstep sounds: now correctly play stone SFX instead of dirt.

Fixed a bug with triple playback of player footstep sounds.

Fixed rat and Shypach sound propagation: sounds now come from correct sources instead of globally.

 Graphics & Environment

Fixed objects without collision.

Returned some objects that fell through textures to their correct positions.

Fixed misplaced grass.

Prologue: Hans now sits in the correct pose.

Fixed incorrect icon for the black claymore (previously displayed as a shovel).

Updated 3D models of creatures: Shypach and Spider — replaced placeholder assets with original, detailed models.

 New Features

Steam Achievements are now available! Explore the world and unlock achievements for various activities.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your feedback and support!
Stay tuned for more updates as we keep improving Step Into the Dark.

🔗 TG - https://t.me/stepintothedark

🔗 Discord - https://discord.gg/AfhmJeQe



— Lightstone Games Team

notes.title: Major Update: Prologue, Progression, Justice – 1.08
notes.content:
We’re back. And with a bang. Update 1.08.
This is the most significant demo update yet: laying the foundation for core mechanics, expanding the lore, and making the game more alive and intriguing.
[hr][/hr][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171201/7a322f8eb45e9c388f7fff54659a38be7fe3e872.png"]New location – Prologue
Start your journey in the underground prison of Dummort – where it all began. Explore the eerie cells, uncover how you became part of this world. Now when you start a new game, choose: begin with the Arena or dive into the Prologue.
[hr][/hr]English localization and voice‑over
We’ve improved the translation and added English voice acting in the Prologue scenes—both main dialogue and ambient lines.
[hr][/hr]Progression & Skills system
Now you can develop your character:

– Earn experience from actions, combat, and quests

– Spend it at teachers for skill points

– Unlock your build with 15 skills, each with 5 mastery tiers—your freedom.
[hr][/hr]Justice & NPCs
– No safe zones: weapons can be drawn anywhere.

– NPCs react to illegal actions and can fight back.

– Loot fallen enemies.

– New Arena characters and quests: Sabretooth & Murky.
[hr][/hr]Inventory & Crafting
– Equipment now has durability—repair at workbenches.

– Expanded crafting: new recipes, tools, upgrades.

– Improved throwing system.

– Quick‑item slots depend on your bag’s quality.
[hr][/hr]Mini‑games
– Dice Poker – start your path to underground poker legend!

– Coin Flip – your chance to get a trader discount.

– Persuasion – a small mini‑game unlocking new NPC interaction options.
[hr][/hr]And Many More Improvements
We squashed countless bugs, enhanced UI & dialogue, updated NPC appearances to fit lore, and made combat more responsive.

notes.title: Update 1.01 – 1.05: New Features, Balancing, and Optimizations
notes.content:
We are excited to present the latest update, which brings a host of changes, improvements, and fixes. Here’s what’s new in Patch 1.01 – 1.05:

— New Content and Mechanics:
A new enemy, the Raptor, has been added to the game, along with a new player ability system that will impact combat and other aspects of gameplay.
Gold and silver coins have been introduced, affecting the in-game economy. You will now collect and spend different types of currency, adding depth to the reward and trade systems.
The lockpicking mini-game has been reworked, making it more challenging but far more engaging. Additionally, kick mechanics have been updated: kicks can now be incorporated into combos, and transitioning from kicks to weapon attacks is smoother.

— Optimization and Balancing:
We’ve significantly improved game performance, rebalanced damage and health levels, and adjusted enemy behavior. For example, ratmen no longer phase through walls. Arena wave balancing has also been updated.

— Interface and Settings:
The interface has been updated with revamped icons and tooltips. HUD elements now disappear when the player’s health and stamina are full. We’ve also introduced an alternative HUD style.
New difficulty settings have been added, along with inventory filters and enhanced dialog and tooltip logic.

— Bug Fixes:
Several critical bugs have been fixed, including item duplication, interface issues, and stamina-related problems. Quest fixes, save logic improvements, and NPC behavior have also been addressed.
The skull tile at the Arena exit has been rotated for smoother passage, and softlock and peaceful zone issues have been resolved.
